JNJ (1W: -0.74% | 1M: +9.82%) CORRECTION and LLY (1W: -1.05% | 1M: +14.26%) CORRECTION retain positive monthly returns, while UNH (1W: -3.81% | 1M: -4.23%) BELOW TREND and PFE (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -1.88%) BELOW TREND are weak.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

Style mixed / no clear leadership: weak breadth does not confirm a Growth or Value style call, and major cross-timeframe divergence makes this a tactical, not core, signal.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

BEARISH: Watch NVDA (1W: -7.95% | 1M: -28.39%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -5.05% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND for continued weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

COST (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +11.67%) ABOVE TREND and AVGO (1W: +2.90% | 1M: +2.10%) ABOVE TREND show relative strength.
